name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Technical Account Manager | APIs & Integrations, Escalations, Adoption & Retention
summary: Client-facing technical account lead with 15+ years in SaaS, owning the relationship and the technical side of the account at the same time. Retained ~94% of a 15-20 partner book at Birdeye while running their technical setup and escalations to Product and Engineering. Guided API integrations and workflow design for CRM and project-management clients at Accelo, advising their executives on system design. Hands-on today with REST APIs, integrations in Zapier, Make, and n8n, Python and JavaScript code steps, working SQL (BigQuery, GA4), and HTML/CSS, integrating CRMs and CMS platforms into client workflows. Translates technical issues into plain language for senior, non-technical stakeholders.
